name: Ops: alert on failed or reversed iswallet payouts
description: When iswallet reports a bank payout as failed, or reverses one it had confirmed, alerts the on-call engineer by SMS and posts to the ops Slack channel.

output.text: ='iswallet payout ' + (trigger.event == 'wallet.outflow.reversed' ? 'REVERSED after it was confirmed' : 'failed') + ': ' + string(double(trigger.body.data.amount) / 100.0) + ' NGN, outflow ' + trigger.body.data.outflow_id + ', wallet ' + trigger.body.data.wallet_id + (has(trigger.body.data.failure_reason) ? ' (' + trigger.body.data.failure_reason + ')' : '')
